title: The shed between 1834 and 1900 Prairie stands open on its posts
items: The narrow strip between 1834 and 1900 Prairie Avenue now has its frame shed on the alley, built to the outline the 1911 fire-insurance map draws: 9.2 m deep and 3.9 m along the alley, against the brick wall of 1900's stable.
The map draws its north and east sides dashed, so they stand open on five posts under a shingled gable, with only the alley side walled in clapboard.
Walk into it from the yard: the roof and walls are boarded inside. All seven alley buildings on this side of the block are now refined from the draft.
